_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Tú ert við at spæla Golf (Kortspæl) - Leikari {player_id}.
Mál: Fáa lægsta samlaða stig í hesi einstaku omgang. Um kolonnur deila sama virði, verða tær roknaðar sum 0.
Kortvirði: A=1, 2-10=andlitvirði, J/Q=10, K=0

Ávirkanir (nýt nákvæm liggi):
- '[draw]' - Dreg til úr dekki
- '[take]' - Taka úr kastabunka
- '[swap X Y]' - Skift dregið kort við posiðjon X (røð) Y (kolonna)
- '[discard]' - Kasta dregið kort

board.drew:
Tú dro ❗️: {card}
Nú mást tú [swap X Y] eller [discard] ta
board.took: Tú hevur tikið: {card} úr burturkastastokkinum. Tær nýtist at [swap X Y] við tí (kann ikki kasta).

options.final_turns: Endaligir omgangir! Tínar valmøguleikar: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Tú mást: [swap X Y] (tú kanst ikki vraka kort úr avlopsstaðnum)

message.deck_empty: Talvan er tóm! Leikurin endar straks.
message.knocked: Leikarin {pid} er tikin! Hvør annar leikari fær eitt umfar afturat.
message.final_round: Spælari {pid} {reason}! Hvør annar spælari fær ein umfar til.

invalid.wrong_action: Nýt nákvæmlega EITT bracketraðað ávirkan: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], eller [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Tú mást fyrst [draw], [take], [knock], ella [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Tú kanst ikki vraka eitt kort, sum tú hevur tikið úr avlopsbunkuni.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Tú hevur eitt dregið kort. Tú mást [swap X Y] eller [discard] ta
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Tú hevur brúk fyri einum kortum til at skifta.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Tú mást hava ein dregin kort at kasta burtur.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posiðjon úti av marki. Nýt røð 1-{max_row}, kolonna 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Tú kanst ikki sláa við einum útgreiddum korti. Endurfør fyrst títt umfar.
invalid.already_knocked: Onkur hevur longu vunnið hendan túrin.
